title: Closed fibres are empty or singleton under point separation
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $Y$ be a scheme over $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Assume that distinct closed points of $X$ have distinct images under $f$. For every closed point $p\in Y$ [def-weil-closed-points], the fibre $f^{-1}(p)$ is either empty or the singleton set $\{x\}$ for one closed point $x\in X$.
